title: GovernanceRefusal
description: The closed vocabulary of AI governance refusal reason codes (ADR-0006 §2.5, ADR-0016 §2.4). These strings appear in logs, metrics, evidence and responses on both sides of the boundary and mean the same thing in all of them.
$comment: Go: ai.RefusalCodes (tested equal). Python: ztax_gateway.governance.Refusal (tested to be a subset; AI_DATA_CLASS_REFUSED is enforced by the Go pre-check and is not yet raised by the Python Gateway, whose UseCase has no data-class allowlist).
